evidence.quote: An important future direction of this work would be to verify if the observations made here hold for HLS based HDL generation.
One major limitation of RTL Agent is its dependency on pre-written test cases.
LLMs are good at generating test cases for software programs, but their performance for hardware tests is currently very limited.
Another area with scope for improvement is the cost overhead of RTL Agent.
Our cost analysis reveals a heuristic that can be used to get some savings, but the method is still many times more costlier than standard generation.

Also, we have observed that even after getting the required feedback from the test bench, LLMs sometimes take multiple iterations to correct their mistakes and in many cases they completely fail to do so.
